 A.  PUBLIC HEARING(S) / HEARING(s)

 1.  Recommendation to conduct a Continued Public Hearing and adopt one of the following

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
REGULAR MEETING
DECEMBER 10, 2025 Page 3
   resolutions as Resolution No. 029-2025:

  A Resolution affirming the Planning Commission’s decision to approve a Minor
  Use Permit for a proposed boat sales business located at 12347 E. Carson Street
  and determining that the project is categorically exempt from the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA); or

  A Resolution overturning the Planning Commission’s decision and denying a
  Minor Use Permit for a proposed boat sales business located at 12347 E. Carson
  Street and determining that the project is categorically exempt from the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA).

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Either affirm the decision of the Planning Commission and
  approve the MUP subject to the same or different conditions of approval or overturn the
  Planning Commission’s decision and adopt appropriate findings to deny the MUP.

  Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, presented the staff report.

  Councilmember De Paula spoke.

  Councilmember Farfan spoke.

  Mayor Del Rio spoke.

  Councilmember Vargas spoke

  Mayor Pro Tem Roa spoke.

  Norma Tabares, City Attorney, spoke.

  Andrew Hard, applicant, spoke.

  A discussion ensued between the Applicant and Councilmembers.

  Mayor De Paula declared a recess at 9:27 PM.

  Mayor De Paula called the meeting back to order at 9:44 PM.

  Scott Birkey, Cox, Castle and Nicholson LLP, spoke.

  A motion was made by Mayor Del Rio, seconded by Councilmember Vargas, to continue
  the Public Hearing to the City Council meeting of Wednesday, February 11, 2026.

  The motion Carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 5; Farfan, Roa, Vargas, Del Rio, De Paula
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 0;
  RECUSE: 0;

  recent changes in state law, and finding the action to be statutorily exempt from CEQA
  under Public Resources Code § 21080.17.
